correctness.rationale: The transient generator [[-2h,2h],[c,-(h+c)]] and absorption vector (0,h) give Laplace transform 2h²/[s²+(3h+c)s+2h²], hence positive distinct hypoexponential rates lambda_± and E[T2]=(3h+c)/(2h²). Its hazard H2=lambda_-lambda_+(1-exp(-(lambda_+-lambda_-)t))/(lambda_+-lambda_-exp(-(lambda_+-lambda_-)t)) strictly increases 0->lambda_-; thus log(S2/exp(-mt)) has initially positive derivative and crosses zero at most once. Characteristic polynomial at m gives lambda_-<=m exactly c>=c_tail=(h-m)(2h-m)/m. For c<c_tail the survival ratio decays to zero and crosses one exactly once. Monotone coupling in c proves t* strictly increases; implicit log survival identity and lambda_-(c)-m~m²(c_tail-c)/(2h²-m²) prove the given divergence coefficient. Difference c_tail-c_mean=m by direct algebra, including c=0, equality and c=c_tail. Independent exact symbolic/numerical verification of Markov resolvent and the m=1,h=2,c=5/2 witness was performed; it is not proof of all-parameter claim.

value.rationale: Fixed-area reserve fragmentation creates a genuine decision gap between an expected extinction time and survival at EVERY horizon. The exact constant m gap and unique critical crossover separate two operational objectives even with the same Markov mechanics. This is a motivated structural threshold and counterexample to inferring late-time benefit from mean longevity, not merely an arbitrary parameter substitution.
